[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > 34.20] (7) The Senior Master will –

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > 34.20] (a) if the claim to be exempt is rejected by the foreign court or tribunal, send the document referred to in paragraph (5)(a) to that court or tribunal;

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > 34.20] (b) if the claim is upheld, send the document to the witness; and

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > 34.20] (c) in either case, notify the witness and person who obtained the order under section 2 of the foreign court or tribunal’s decision. ## Order under 1975 Act as applied by Patents Act 1977

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > Order under 1975 Act as applied by Patents Act 1977] 34.21 Where an order is made for the examination of witnesses under section 1 of the 1975 Act as applied by section 92 of the Patents Act 1977 1 the court may permit an officer of the European Patent Office to –

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > Order under 1975 Act as applied by Patents Act 1977] (a) attend the examination and examine the witnesses; or

[PART 34 – WITNESSES, DEPOSITIONS AND EVIDENCE FOR FOREIGN COURTS > Order under 1975 Act as applied by Patents Act 1977] (b) request the court or the examiner before whom the examination takes place to put specified questions to them. ## Footnotes
